name: Empire of Man
description: The Empire relies on disciplined soldiers, black powder weapons, and the might of its warrior priests.

name: Bretonnia
description: Bretonnian knights are peerless cavalry, bound by chivalric vows and the blessing of the Lady.

name: Warriors of Chaos
description: Chaos Warriors are heavily armoured champions blessed by the Dark Gods.

name: Orcs & Goblins
description: Greenskins live for battle, their Waaagh! energy growing with each victory.

name: Dwarf Mountain Holds
description: Dwarfs are dour, stubborn, and unyielding, with peerless smithcraft.

name: Wood Elves
description: Wood Elves move through the forests like ghosts, striking where least expected.

name: High Elves
description: High Elves are the most graceful and skilled warriors of the Old World.

name: Beastmen Brayherds
description: Beastmen are savage warherds that rampage from the deep forests.

name: Tomb Kings of Khemri
description: The Tomb Kings are ancient undead rulers commanding legions of bone and stone.

name: Vampire Counts
description: Vampire Lords are ancient, powerful undead who command legions of the damned.

name: Skaven
description: The Skaven are a limitless tide of ratmen, treacherous and inventive.

name: Dark Elves
description: Dark Elves are cruel, ruthless raiders from the frozen lands of Naggaroth.

name: Lizardmen
description: Lizardmen are the cold-blooded servants of the Old Ones, defending the world's primal order.
